description_text: Evidence for this entry is tied to Nidek Mark 5 Nuvo Lite model 925, 230 V/50 Hz, and must not be applied to every Nuvo Lite family variant. The official family IFU lists 0.125–5 L/min, 87–95.5% at 5 L/min, 14.5 kg, and 300 W average for model 925. A 925 brochure gives 90% (+6.5%/−3%) at 5 L/min and 40 dBA typical, while the official family IFU noise specification is <58 dBA and the OCSI guide gives 45 to <40 dBA depending on model. Concentration and sound therefore need confirmation against the exact offered unit and document revision. Verify India-supplied model, OCSI fitment, price, package, warranty, and local service. Sources: https://www.nidekmedical.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/2010-8401ce-rev-g-ifu-nuvo-lite-family.pdf ; https://www.somatco.com/NuvoLite-Mark5-NIDEK.pdf ; https://www.nidekmedical.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/2010-8401ce-rev-b-nuvo-lite-ocsi-english-single.pdf.
